name: T2S-Bench-MR
description:
T2S-Bench & Structure-of-Thought
  Benchmarking Comprehensive Text-to-Structure Reasoning



    🌐 Project Page • 📚 Paper • 🤗 T2S-Bench Dataset • 
    📊 Leaderboard • 🔮 Examples
 



T2S-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating models' ability to extract structured representations from scientific text. It includes three curated components: T2S-Train-1.2k for training, T2S-Bench-MR (500 samples) for multi-hop reasoning, and T2S-Bench-E2E (87 samples) for end-to-end… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/T2SBench/T2S-Bench-MR.
evaluation_method: exact_match and structure-level F1 (e.g., graph/slot F1) for extracted structured representations; sequence/field F1 variants are also used
reputation: Emerging benchmark for text-to-structure extraction and multi-hop scientific reasoning with a public dataset and leaderboard gaining traction in research groups focused on structured reasoning.
